
# Giant CSV for every park for every month of October 2022 to September 2026

load libraries:
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tsibble)
library(tidyterra)
```
NO MORE MEAN DIFFERENCE

Turn all the monthly rasters from October 2020 to September 2026 per pixel into csv per park

Column format:
park name | month | year | variable | stats | value
variable and stats will be: mean NDVI, mean NDMI, mean monthly mean temp, mean monthly max temp, mean monthly min temp, max monthly max temp, min monthly min temp, cumulative monthly precip, monthly mean daily precip

Initiatilise the tibble:
```{r}
csv_all <- tibble(
    name = character(),
    month = double(),
    year = double(),
    variable = character(),
    stats = character(),
    value = double()
)
```

Parks vectors:
```{r}
parks_vectors <- do.call(rbind, lapply(list.files("data/shp/parks", pattern = "\\.gpkg$", full.names = TRUE), terra::vect))
```
First: collect the rasters
NDVIMI: `data/geotiff/ndvimi/individual_years` 
precip: `/data/geotiff/climate_v2/precip/individual_years`
temp: `/data/geotiff/climate_v2/temp/individual_years`

Second: clip against the park shapes `data/shp/parks`
(make a function)

Third: add row to the dataframe 

```{r}
ndvimi_files <- list.files("data/geotiff/ndvimi/individual_years", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.tif$")
ndvimi_stack <- terra::rast(ndvimi_files)
ndvi_stack <- ndvimi_stack[[names(ndvimi_stack) == "NDVI"]]
ndmi_stack <- ndvimi_stack[[names(ndvimi_stack) == "NDMI"]]
# now to clip against park shapes

for (i in 1:nrow(parks_vectors)){
    park_vector <- parks_vectors[i]
    print(sprintf("checking NDVIMI of %s", park_vector$NAME))
    park_vector <- terra::project(park_vector, "EPSG:32648")
    ndvi_stack_cropped <- terra::crop(ndvi_stack, park_vector)
    ndvi_stack_masked <- terra::mask(ndvi_stack_cropped, park_vector)
    ndmi_stack_cropped <- terra::crop(ndmi_stack, park_vector)
    ndmi_stack_masked <- terra::mask(ndmi_stack_cropped, park_vector)
    output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","per_park_per_year","ndvimi_",park_vector$NAME)
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    for (n in 1:length(sources(ndvimi_stack))){
        base_path <- basename(sources(ndvimi_stack)[n])
        pattern <- "_([0-9]{4})_([0-9]{1,2})\\.tif$"
        matches <- regmatches(base_path, regexec(pattern, base_path))[[1]]
        year <- as.double(matches[2])
        month <- as.double(matches[3])
        print(sprintf("Checking %d %02d", year, month))
        ndvi <- ndvi_stack_masked[[n]]
        ndmi <- ndmi_stack_masked[[n]]
        ndvi_vals <- terra::values(ndvi, mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        # find the mean ndvi
        mean_ndvi <- mean(ndvi_vals)
        # find the SD ndvi
        sd_ndvi <- sd(ndvi_vals)
        ndmi_vals <- terra::values(ndmi, mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        mean_ndmi <- mean(ndmi_vals)
        sd_ndmi <- sd(ndmi_vals)
        csv_all <- csv_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month = month,
                variable = "ndvi",
                stats = "mean_ndvi",
                value = mean_ndvi
            ) |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month = month,
                variable = "ndvi",
                stats = "sd_ndvi",
                value = sd_ndvi
            )   |>
                add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month = month,
                variable = "ndmi",
                stats = "mean_ndmi",
                value = mean_ndmi
            )   |>
                add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month = month,
                variable = "ndmi",
                stats = "sd_ndmi",
                value = sd_ndmi
            )  |>
            add_row(name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME, 
            year = year, 
            month = month,
            variable = "ndvi", 
            stats = "n_pixels", 
            value = length(ndvi_vals)) |>
            add_row(name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME, 
            year = year, 
            month = month,
            variable = "ndmi", 
            stats = "n_pixels", 
            value = length(ndmi_vals))

        output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(park_vector$NAME, base_path))
        ndvimi_layers <- c(ndvi, ndmi)
        terra::writeRaster(ndvimi_layers, output_file,overwrite=TRUE)
    }
}
```

precip:

```{r}
precip_files <- list.files("data/geotiff/climate_v2/precip/individual_years", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.tif$")
precip_stack <- terra::rast(precip_files)
daily_sum_stack <- precip_stack[[names(precip_stack) == "mean_monthly_daily_sum"]]
cumulative_stack <- precip_stack[[names(precip_stack) == "cumulative_monthly"]]
for (i in 1:nrow(parks_vectors)){
    park_vector <- parks_vectors[i]
    print(sprintf("checking precip of %s", park_vector$NAME))
    park_vector <- terra::project(park_vector, "EPSG:32648")
    daily_sum_masked <- terra::mask(terra::crop(daily_sum_stack, park_vector), park_vector)
    cumulative_masked <- terra::mask(terra::crop(cumulative_stack, park_vector), park_vector)
    output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","per_park_per_year","precip_",park_vector$NAME)
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    for (n in 1:length(sources(precip_stack))){
        base_path <- basename(sources(precip_stack)[n])
        pattern <- "_([0-9]{4})_([0-9]{1,2})\\.tif$"
        matches <- regmatches(base_path, regexec(pattern, base_path))[[1]]
        year <- as.double(matches[2])
        month <- as.double(matches[3])
        print(sprintf("Checking %d %02d", year, month))
        mean_monthly_daily_sum_precip_vals <- terra::values(daily_sum_masked[[n]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        cumulative_monthly_precip_vals <- terra::values(cumulative_masked[[n]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        csv_all <- csv_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month = month,
                variable = "precip",
                stats = "mean_monthly_daily_sum_precip",
                value = mean(mean_monthly_daily_sum_precip_vals)
            )
        csv_all <- csv_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month = month,
                variable = "precip",
                stats = "cumulative_monthly_precip",
                value = mean(cumulative_monthly_precip_vals)
            )
        output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(park_vector$NAME, base_path))
        terra::writeRaster(c(daily_sum_masked[[n]], cumulative_masked[[n]]), output_file, overwrite=TRUE)
    }
}
```

temp:
```{r}
temp_files <- list.files("data/geotiff/climate_v2/temp/individual_years", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.tif$")
temp_stack <- terra::rast(temp_files)
mean_monthly_mean_stack <- temp_stack[[names(temp_stack) == "mean_monthly_mean"]]
mean_monthly_max_stack <- temp_stack[[names(temp_stack) == "mean_monthly_max"]]
mean_monthly_min_stack <- temp_stack[[names(temp_stack) == "mean_monthly_min"]]
max_monthly_max_stack <- temp_stack[[names(temp_stack) == "max_monthly_max"]]
min_monthly_min_stack <- temp_stack[[names(temp_stack) == "min_monthly_min"]]
for (i in 1:nrow(parks_vectors)){
    park_vector <- parks_vectors[i]
    print(sprintf("checking temp of %s", park_vector$NAME))
    park_vector <- terra::project(park_vector, "EPSG:32648")
    mean_monthly_mean_masked <- terra::mask(terra::crop(mean_monthly_mean_stack , park_vector), park_vector)
    mean_monthly_max_masked <- terra::mask(terra::crop(mean_monthly_max_stack, park_vector), park_vector)
    mean_monthly_min_masked <- terra::mask(terra::crop(mean_monthly_min_stack, park_vector), park_vector)
    max_monthly_max_masked <- terra::mask(terra::crop(max_monthly_max_stack, park_vector), park_vector)
    min_monthly_min_masked <- terra::mask(terra::crop(min_monthly_min_stack, park_vector), park_vector)
    output_dir <- here("data","geotiff","per_park_per_year","temp_",park_vector$NAME)
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    for (n in 1:length(sources(temp_stack))){
        base_path <- basename(sources(temp_stack)[n])
        pattern <- "_([0-9]{4})_([0-9]{1,2})\\.tif$"
        matches <- regmatches(base_path, regexec(pattern, base_path))[[1]]
        year <- as.double(matches[2])
        month <- as.double(matches[3])
        print(sprintf("Checking %d %02d", year, month))
        mean_monthly_max_temp_vals <- terra::values(mean_monthly_max_masked[[n]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        csv_all <- csv_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month=month,
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "mean_monthly_max_temp",
                value = mean(mean_monthly_max_temp_vals)
            )
        mean_monthly_mean_temp_vals <- terra::values(mean_monthly_mean_masked[[n]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        csv_all <- csv_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month=month,
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "mean_monthly_mean_temp",
                value = mean(mean_monthly_mean_temp_vals)
            )
        mean_monthly_min_temp_vals <- terra::values(mean_monthly_min_masked[[n]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        csv_all <- csv_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month=month,
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "mean_monthly_min_temp",
                value = mean(mean_monthly_min_temp_vals)
            )
        max_monthly_max_temp_vals <- terra::values(max_monthly_max_masked[[n]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        csv_all <- csv_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month=month,
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "max_monthly_max_temp",
                value = mean(max_monthly_max_temp_vals)
            )
        min_monthly_min_temp_vals <- terra::values(min_monthly_min_masked[[n]], mat = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        csv_all <- csv_all |>
            add_row(
                name = parks_vectors[i]$NAME,
                year = year,
                month=month,
                variable = "temp",
                stats = "min_monthly_min_temp",
                value = mean(min_monthly_min_temp_vals)
            )
        output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(park_vector$NAME, base_path))
        terra::writeRaster(c(mean_monthly_max_masked[[n]], mean_monthly_mean_masked[[n]], mean_monthly_min_masked[[n]], max_monthly_max_masked[[n]], min_monthly_min_masked[[n]]), output_file, overwrite=TRUE)
    }
}
```

Fourth: save as CSV 

```{r}
write_csv(csv_all, "data/csv/parks_all_years.csv")
```

Turning the statistics figures into shape files too so that I can plot them better for the presentation:
1. pivot the csv_all dataframe wider 
2. use tidyterra to join parks_vectors with the wider csv_all

```{r}
wider_csv_all <- csv_all |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c("name", "year", "month"), names_from = "stats", values_from = "value")

parks_vectors_joined <- parks_vectors |>
    select(NAME) |>
    inner_join(wider_csv_all, by = c("NAME" = "name")) |>
    mutate(across(!NAME, ~as.double(.x)))

terra::writeVector(parks_vectors_joined, here("data", "shp", "parks_stats.gpkg"),overwrite=TRUE)
```
